about_the_game:
Driving Rogue plunges you into a high-speed rogue-like challenge where every race is a fight for survival and mastery. Navigate treacherous city streets, execute precise manoeuvres, and beat your own and others high scores to reach the very top!

Core Gameplay

Drive, drift, and deploy unique abilities to dominate the roads. Master the art of precision driving to finish each level with both style and speed to progress further and unlock potent upgrades, fresh challenges and new vehicles.

London at Night

Experience riding through a neon-clad London at night, with all the iconic vehicles and spots for you to find and... mainly avoid. Accompanied by a diverse soundtrack that complements the game's nocturnal adrenaline filled action. There's always something new to see and a fresh challenge to attempt so there's no shortage of roads to master & places to visit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 15063.0 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 @2.3 GHz or AMD Dual-Core Athlon 2.4 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: 9.0c compliant
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 – 8600K (3.6 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X (3.6 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 (2GB) / AMD Radeon RX 570 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: 9.0c compliant
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Tactical drifting meets roguelike chaos. Race through a changing cityscape, outmaneuver hazards, and push your score to the limit. No run, ride, or road is ever the same.
